segments.title: Lead Story: Historic Trilateral in Shenzhen
segments.classification: VERIFIED (arrivals, greetings, scheduled talks) / REPORTED (specific agenda outcomes still developing)
segments.sources: 【entity-Reuters¦canonical_name=Reuters】, 【entity-The Guardian¦canonical_name=The Guardian】, 【entity-PBS NewsHour¦canonical_name=PBS NewsHour】, multiple wire reports 18-19 November 2026.
segments.narration: In Shenzhen, Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted U.S. President 【entity-Donald Trump¦canonical_name=Donald Trump】 on the tarmac — a rare gesture. Russian President Vladimir Putin joined them for handshakes, a group photo, and a banquet on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Formal trilateral talks are the focus of today. Reported topics include the war in Ukraine, the situation involving Iran, nuclear arms control, trade, and artificial intelligence. Xi and Putin earlier delivered speeches criticizing protectionism and sanctions. This is the first time these three leaders have sat down together in this format.
segments.discussion: What does a first-ever formal trilateral among these three powers mean for African nations that have long navigated multipolar diplomacy?

segments.title: Liberia Maritime Dialogue & UNSC Path
segments.sources: Liberia Maritime Authority announcements, The New Dawn, GNN Liberia, Ministry of Information briefings, 17-18 November 2026.
segments.narration: Today in Marshall, Margibi County, Liberia hosts a high-level Global Maritime Security Dialogue under the theme of enhancing safety, security, and the welfare of seafarers. The gathering comes as Liberia prepares to assume the rotating presidency of the United Nations Security Council in December — the first time in 65 years. President Joseph Nyuma Boakai is expected to deliver a keynote. The dialogue addresses piracy, cyber threats, illegal fishing, and the responsibilities that come with Liberia's position as a major flag state. This builds on the recent adoption of Liberia's Feminist Foreign Policy.
segments.hesed_note: Maritime insecurity directly affects African coastal economies, food supply chains, and the safety of seafarers from the continent.
segments.discussion: How can Liberia use its upcoming Security Council presidency and maritime leadership to elevate African priorities on the global stage?

segments.title: Additional Story: U.S. Political Shift
segments.narration: In the United States, Democrat Mary Peltola has won the Alaska Senate race, contributing to a projected 56-seat Democratic majority in the new Senate. 【entity-House Democrats¦canonical_name=House Democrats】 have formally nominated 【entity-Hakeem Jeffries¦canonical_name=Hakeem Jeffries】 for Speaker of the House, positioning him to become the first Black lawmaker to hold that role. These developments follow the recent midterm elections and will shape the legislative landscape the incoming Congress inherits.
segments.discussion: How might shifts in U.S. congressional leadership affect African policy priorities, trade, and diplomatic engagement?
